# Data Description
- Author: 蔡睿燊
- Date first created: 20261108
- Background: 2025 年臺北市 YouBike 2.0 站點即時車位歷史紀錄（交通部 TDX 平臺），只保留研究範圍（臺大／公館一帶多邊形）及人工補入的 109 個站點。規格與處理規則比照 2024 年版本（[文件](youbike_rental_in_field_2024_doc.Rmd)）；站點清單比 2024 年版本多 `臺大人文館`（`TPE500119097`，2025-02-04 啟用）與 `羅斯福路三段283巷`（`TPE500101265`，2025-10-10 啟用）。本組研究臺大周遭站點的車輛數最適化調度，這份資料提供各站可借車數與可還空位的時間序列。
- Unit of observation: 站點 × 來源更新時間（`StationUID` × `SrcUpdateTime`），一列為一次站點狀態更新；兩者組合唯一。
- Sample period: 2025-01-01 00:00 至 2025-12-31 23:58（Asia/Taipei）；365 天中 362 天有資料。
- Known issues:
    - **3 天沒有資料**：2025-02-12、02-17、02-27。原始檔只有 1 列，且該列不屬於研究範圍，不是處理時刪除的。
    - **紀錄頻率在下半年明顯變稀**：同站相鄰兩筆的間隔中位數在 1–3 月約 2 分鐘（90% 分位約 9–12 分鐘），8 月起升到 4 分鐘左右，12 月達 7 分鐘（90% 分位 50 分鐘）；每站每日列數由 3 月的約 267 列降到 12 月的約 65 列。全年每日列數中位數 11,159 列，約為 2024 年（25,134 列）的一半。目前無法分辨這是來源更新頻率改變還是實際使用量變化，**跨月或與 2024 年比較列數前，應先整理成固定時間間隔**；間隔變長也會降低短時段狀態的精確度。
    - **個別站點有整段缺漏**：`和平東路二段90巷`（`TPE500101234`）缺 2025-07-03 至 08-27 共 56 天；`臺大獸醫館南側`（`TPE500119089`）缺 2025-11-15 至 12-02 共 18 天。新站 `臺大人文館` 自 2025-02-04 起 328 天有資料，`羅斯福路三段283巷` 自 2025-10-10 起 83 天有資料。
    - **`ServiceStatus` 已重新編碼**：與 2024 年相同，原始代碼 `2`（54 列，2024 年為 20,662 列）依組員確認改為「停止營運」，分布在 8 站，最多為 `TPE500101012`（23 列）。停止營運時車數仍有數值（平均可借 1.9 輛），分析時通常應排除或另行處理。
    - `AvailableRentBikes` 全部等於 `GeneralBikes + ElectricBikes`。
    - `AvailableRentBikes + AvailableReturnBikes` 在同一站內不是固定值（可能因車柱故障或容量調整等），不能直接當作站點容量；2025 年有數站在年中擴充容量（見站位快照的 `BikesCapacity`）。
    - `UpdateTime` 通常比 `SrcUpdateTime` 晚約 29 秒，但 14,341 列早幾秒，最大相差 13,953 秒（約 3.9 小時）；時間分析以 `SrcUpdateTime` 為準。
- Definition for each variable:
    - 定義取自 TDX OAS 規格（見 [raw codebook](../raw/youbike_rental_codebook.md)），「本檔處理」欄記錄 [處理程式](../code/youbike_rental_in_field_2025.Rmd) 所做的改變；數值範圍來自下方 Summary Stats 的實際輸出。

| Field | R type | Description | Values / range | 本檔處理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `StationUID` | character | 站點唯一識別代碼，{業管機關代碼} + {StationID} | 109 個值，皆以 `TPE` 開頭，皆屬於 [stations_in_field.csv](stations_in_field.csv) | 依此欄篩選研究範圍站點 |
| `StationID` | character | 站點代碼 | 109 個值，等於 `StationUID` 去掉 `TPE` | 以文字讀入，保留前導格式 |
| `ServiceStatus` | character | 服務狀態 | 「正常營運」5,766,474 列；「停止營運」54 列 | 原始代碼 `2` 改為「停止營運」 |
| `ServiceType` | character | 服務類型 | 全為 `YouBike2` | 保留原始文字 |
| `AvailableRentBikes` | integer | 可租借車數 | 0–99 | 文字轉整數 |
| `AvailableReturnBikes` | integer | 可歸還空位數 | 0–99 | 文字轉整數 |
| `SrcUpdateTime` | POSIXct（Asia/Taipei） | 來源端平臺資料更新時間 | 2025-01-01 00:00:16 至 2025-12-31 23:58:03 | ISO 8601 字串轉為時間 |
| `UpdateTime` | POSIXct（Asia/Taipei） | TDX 資料更新時間 | 2025-01-01 00:00:51 至 2025-12-31 23:58:36 | ISO 8601 字串轉為時間 |
| `GeneralBikes` | integer | 一般自行車可租借車數 | 0–99 | 文字轉整數 |
| `ElectricBikes` | integer | 電動輔助車可租借車數 | 0–37，多數為 0 | 文字轉整數 |
| `source_date` | Date | 該列所屬原始檔的日期（取自檔名） | 2025-01-01 至 2025-12-31，362 個日期；與 `SrcUpdateTime` 的日期一致 | 新增欄位 |

- Data path: `data/processed/youbike_rental_in_field_2025.parquet` (the exact file this notebook reads)
- Source data: `data/raw/youbike_rental_raw/臺北市公共自行車站點剩餘數量歷史資料2025-MM-DD.CSV`（365 檔，逐檔路徑與 SHA-256 見 `data/code/youbike_rental_raw_manifest_2025.csv`）；站點清單 `data/processed/stations_in_field.csv`
- Processing code: `data/code/youbike_rental_in_field_2025.Rmd`
- Role: `analysis`
- Verification status: 2026-11-08 以乾淨 R 程序 knit 本檔，下方 Assertions 全部通過（結果見文末「執行結果」）。
- SHA-256: `b11534cbd9b416a614ed2dc5941ea655f90421c76886a0b77a35876b57ac2b82`
- Downstream analysis input: `data/processed/youbike_rental_in_field_2025.parquet` (must equal Data path)

Keep these paths and the `PROJECT-PROPOSAL.md` Data Artifacts row consistent. The source
and processing links describe lineage; later finding notebooks read this exact
processed file.

讀取方式：`arrow::read_parquet()` 回傳一般 tibble，整數與含時區的時間型別會保留，不需另外設定欄位型別。

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "AGENTS.md")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "templates"))) return(candidate)
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) stop("Open this notebook within the student project containing AGENTS.md and templates/.")
    candidate <- parent
  }
}
PROJECT_ROOT <- find_project_root()

project_file <- function(relative_path, area, must_exist = TRUE) {
  # Exact project-relative paths only; no first-file search or OS-root /data path.
  parts <- strsplit(relative_path, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (grepl("^(/|~|[A-Za-z]:)", relative_path) || ".." %in% parts ||
      grepl("<", relative_path, fixed = TRUE) ||
      !startsWith(relative_path, paste0("data/", area, "/"))) {
    stop("Replace the placeholder with an exact path inside data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, relative_path)
  if (must_exist && (!file.exists(path) || dir.exists(path))) stop("Input file not found: ", path)
  # Resolve existing ancestors to reject a path that leaves the project via a symlink.
  ancestor <- path
  while (!file.exists(ancestor)) ancestor <- dirname(ancestor)
  resolved <- normalizePath(ancestor, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  allowed <- normalizePath(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", area), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!startsWith(allowed, paste0(PROJECT_ROOT, "/"))) {
    stop("data/", area, "/ resolves outside the project root.")
  }
  if (!identical(resolved, allowed) && !startsWith(resolved, paste0(allowed, "/"))) {
    stop("Resolved path leaves data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path
}

sha256_file <- function(path) {
  if (!requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Cannot verify input identity: digest is unavailable. Use an available SHA-256 implementation before loading data.")
  }
  digest::digest(file = path, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
}

verify_input_sha256 <- function(path, expected) {
  # Bind this run to the exact file inspected when the notebook was prepared.
  if (!is.character(expected) || length(expected) != 1L || is.na(expected) ||
      !grepl("^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$", expected)) {
    stop("Fill the expected SHA-256 from the inspected input before loading data.")
  }
  actual <- sha256_file(path)
  if (!identical(actual, tolower(expected))) stop("Input changed: identify the new version before loading ", basename(path), ".")
  actual
}
```

## Change for Your Own Data

```{r}
INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH <- "data/processed/youbike_rental_in_field_2025.parquet"
input_data_file <- project_file(INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH, "processed")
EXPECTED_COLUMNS <- c(
  "StationUID", "StationID", "ServiceStatus", "ServiceType",
  "AvailableRentBikes", "AvailableReturnBikes", "SrcUpdateTime", "UpdateTime",
  "GeneralBikes", "ElectricBikes", "source_date"
)
EXPECTED_ROWS <- 5766528L # From the processing notebook's verified run.
EXPECTED_SHA256 <- "b11534cbd9b416a614ed2dc5941ea655f90421c76886a0b77a35876b57ac2b82"

# Station list used by the processing notebook, for the membership check.
STATIONS_RELATIVE_PATH <- "data/processed/stations_in_field.csv"
stations_file <- project_file(STATIONS_RELATIVE_PATH, "processed")
STATIONS_SHA256 <- "74dadd7afe58f0b69b0a511f234dc85388e64290d5db420b8426767bad637f9e"
```

## Summary

```{r}
input_fingerprint <- verify_input_sha256(input_data_file, EXPECTED_SHA256)
df <- read_parquet(input_data_file)

stations_fingerprint <- verify_input_sha256(stations_file, STATIONS_SHA256)
field_station_ids <- read_csv(stations_file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) |>
  pull(StationUID) |>
  unique()

print(list(data_path = INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH, rows = nrow(df),
           schema = map_chr(df, \(column) paste(class(column), collapse = "/")),
           sha256 = input_fingerprint))
```

```{r}
# Categorical columns and coverage
df |>
  count(ServiceStatus, ServiceType)

df |>
  summarise(
    stations = n_distinct(StationUID),
    days_with_rows = n_distinct(source_date),
    first_update = min(SrcUpdateTime),
    last_update = max(SrcUpdateTime)
  )

# Rows per station and per day
df |>
  count(StationUID) |>
  summarise(min_rows = min(n), median_rows = median(n), max_rows = max(n))

df |>
  count(source_date) |>
  summarise(min_rows = min(n), median_rows = median(n), max_rows = max(n))
```

```{r}
# Relationships described in Known issues (reported, not asserted)
update_lag_seconds <- as.numeric(df$UpdateTime - df$SrcUpdateTime, units = "secs")

tibble(
  rent_not_general_plus_electric = sum(df$AvailableRentBikes != df$GeneralBikes + df$ElectricBikes),
  update_before_source = sum(update_lag_seconds < 0),
  median_update_lag_seconds = median(update_lag_seconds),
  max_update_lag_seconds = max(update_lag_seconds)
)

# Bike availability while 停止營運
df |>
  group_by(ServiceStatus) |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    mean_rent_bikes = mean(AvailableRentBikes),
    mean_return_docks = mean(AvailableReturnBikes)
  )

# Dates with no rows
all_dates <- seq(as.Date("2025-01-01"), as.Date("2025-12-31"), by = "day")
all_dates[!all_dates %in% df$source_date]
```

```{r}
# Update frequency by month: rows per station-day and gap between consecutive
# updates of the same station within a day (reported, not asserted)
df |>
  arrange(StationUID, SrcUpdateTime) |>
  group_by(StationUID, source_date) |>
  mutate(gap_minutes = as.numeric(SrcUpdateTime - lag(SrcUpdateTime), units = "mins")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(month = format(source_date, "%Y-%m")) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    rows_per_station_day = n() / n_distinct(StationUID, source_date),
    median_gap_minutes = median(gap_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    p90_gap_minutes = quantile(gap_minutes, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Stations present on fewer than 350 days, with first and last dates
df |>
  group_by(StationUID) |>
  summarise(first_date = min(source_date), last_date = max(source_date), days = n_distinct(source_date)) |>
  filter(days < 350)

# 停止營運 rows by station
df |>
  filter(ServiceStatus == "停止營運") |>
  count(StationUID, sort = TRUE)
```

### Assertions

```{r}
stopifnot(identical(names(df), EXPECTED_COLUMNS))
stopifnot(nrow(df) == EXPECTED_ROWS)

# Types preserved by Parquet
stopifnot(
  all(map_lgl(df[c("StationUID", "StationID", "ServiceStatus", "ServiceType")], is.character)),
  all(map_lgl(df[c("AvailableRentBikes", "AvailableReturnBikes", "GeneralBikes", "ElectricBikes")], is.integer)),
  inherits(df$SrcUpdateTime, "POSIXct"),
  inherits(df$UpdateTime, "POSIXct"),
  identical(attr(df$SrcUpdateTime, "tzone"), "Asia/Taipei"),
  inherits(df$source_date, "Date")
)

# Key, coverage and allowed values set by the processing notebook
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(df),
  !anyDuplicated(select(df, StationUID, SrcUpdateTime)),
  all(df$StationUID %in% field_station_ids),
  n_distinct(df$StationUID) == length(field_station_ids),
  all(df$StationID == str_remove(df$StationUID, "^TPE")),
  all(df$ServiceStatus %in% c("正常營運", "停止營運")),
  all(df$ServiceType == "YouBike2"),
  all(df$AvailableRentBikes >= 0),
  all(df$AvailableReturnBikes >= 0),
  all(df$GeneralBikes >= 0),
  all(df$ElectricBikes >= 0),
  all(as.Date(df$SrcUpdateTime, tz = "Asia/Taipei") == df$source_date)
)

actual_sha256 <- sha256_file(input_data_file)
if (!identical(actual_sha256, input_fingerprint)) stop("File changed during documentation: inspect the new version.")
print(list(data_path = INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH, rows = nrow(df), columns = names(df),
           sha256 = actual_sha256,
           status = "configured checks passed"))
```

## 執行結果

2026-11-08 以乾淨 R 程序（`Rscript --vanilla`，`knitr::knit()` 輸出至暫存位置）執行，所有 Assertions 通過。實際輸出摘要：

- 5,766,528 列 × 11 欄，欄位名稱、順序與型別和 2024 年版本相同；無缺值；(`StationUID`, `SrcUpdateTime`) 無重複；109 站全部屬於站點清單且都有資料。
- `ServiceStatus`：「正常營運」5,766,474 列、「停止營運」54 列。停止營運時平均可借 1.91 輛、可還 12.1 位；正常營運時為 11.1 與 21.3。
- 每站列數 3,208–168,023（中位數 48,767）；每日列數 1,999–40,002（中位數 11,159）。
- 沒有資料的日期：2025-02-12、02-17、02-27。
- 每月同站更新間隔中位數：1–3 月約 2 分鐘，4 月 3 分鐘，5–7 月約 2 分鐘，8–9 月約 4 分鐘，10 月 3 分鐘，11 月 5 分鐘，12 月 7 分鐘。
- 不足 350 天的站：`TPE500101234` 306 天、`TPE500101265` 83 天、`TPE500119089` 344 天、`TPE500119097` 328 天。
- `AvailableRentBikes` ≠ `GeneralBikes + ElectricBikes` 共 0 列；`UpdateTime` 早於 `SrcUpdateTime` 共 14,341 列；兩者相差中位數 29 秒、最大 13,953 秒。
- SHA-256：`b11534cbd9b416a614ed2dc5941ea655f90421c76886a0b77a35876b57ac2b82`
